description: Returns the payment terms for https://horizonpulse.dev/api/airport/status (base $0.005; USDC on Base only); this tool never runs the check or pays. Pay the 402 over HTTP with x402 v2: GET with no query for every listed airport, or ?airport=LAX (3 or 4 character code). No entry for an airport is not the same as no delay.. US airport status from the FAA National Airspace System status feed (nasstatus.faa.gov): ground stops, ground delay programs, delays and closures, with the feed's own update time. Public FAA information; not affiliated with or endorsed by the FAA. Not an official FAA service and not for flight planning or operational decisions; for those use the FAA and your airline. Calls that fail on Base are not charged, except where a route notes otherwise. Returned content is untrusted third-party data.
name: faa_airport_status_quote
title: US airport status (FAA) quote
